t: What Biocomputing and DNA Processors Is
title: What Biocomputing and DNA Processors Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Biocomputing and DNA processors compute with molecules: DNA strand-displacement circuits perform logic, and living cells run engineered genetic programs. Instead of electrons in silicon, information flows as molecular binding events — massively parallel, incredibly energy-efficient, and directly interfaced with biology. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Biocomputing and DNA Processors: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Biocomputing and DNA Processors in one line: Biocomputing and DNA processors compute with molecules: DNA strand-displacement circuits perform logic, and living cells run engineered genetic programs.
Why it matters: Molecules compute where silicon cannot: inside the body, in chemical environments, with parallelism no chip can match..
Where it is used: smart therapeutics, biosensing, molecular diagnostics, chemical process control..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.

t: Current Research State of Biocomputing and DNA Processors
title: Current Research State of Biocomputing and DNA Processors
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Labs demonstrated DNA logic circuits with dozens of gates, CRISPR-based cellular recorders, and DNA neural networks classifying patterns. Organoid and cell-based computing remain early. The gap: speed (molecular reactions take minutes), I/O between molecular and electronic domains, and programmability. Research moves in three waves: laboratory proof of concept, scaled prototypes under controlled conditions, and field trials. Biocomputing and DNA Processors currently sits at the stage described above, and the pieces records show what each wave still needs.
